explanation: Two related jobs at 'unfinished unit' boundaries. (1) Strongest (about 0.7-1.0 of max): the first sub-word piece of a word the tokenizer splits, where that piece is not a word itself and needs continuing, such as ' cl' in clamped/claret/clings/clutched/clumped, ' compl' in complacent, ' he' in heus/heksejakt, ' He' in Heian, ' qu' in quagmire, ' O' in Opheltes. The same word written as one token (clumsy, complete, cloud) gets no peak. (2) Sentence-final punctuation ('.', '?', '!', '...') in informal first-person forum or Q&A prose ('I really don't see where the problem is.') reaches about 0.75-0.9 of max, while the same punctuation in impersonal news or narrative prose stays at about 0.25-0.45; tokens that are neither stay near 0.
